# Golden Valley Cyber

> Golden Valley Cyber is a cyber security consultancy in Cheltenham, UK, providing security audits, ISO 27001 implementation, application security testing, vulnerability scanning and penetration testing.

Golden Valley Cyber is a trading name of Soft Innovators UK Ltd (company number 06890751), Frogmore House, 6 Ormond Place, Cheltenham GL50 1JD. It is not a CREST member; its penetration testing follows CREST-style methodology. Case studies on this site are illustrative scenarios, not named client results.

## Services

### Audits and compliance
- [PCI DSS](https://gvcyber.com/services/pci-dss): Any company processing or storing card payments.
- [ISO 27001](https://gvcyber.com/services/iso-27001): Organisations that need a structured information security management system.
- [SOC 2 (Type I / Type II)](https://gvcyber.com/services/soc-2): SaaS and technology companies handling customer data.
- [Cyber Essentials](https://gvcyber.com/services/cyber-essentials): UK organisations and suppliers seeking a recognised baseline certification.
- [Cyber Essentials Plus](https://gvcyber.com/services/cyber-essentials-plus): UK organisations needing independently tested Cyber Essentials controls.
- [GDPR Compliance](https://gvcyber.com/services/gdpr-compliance): Organisations processing personal data belonging to people in the UK or EU.
- [ISO 42001 (AI Management)](https://gvcyber.com/services/iso-42001): Organisations developing, supplying or using AI systems.
- [HIPAA](https://gvcyber.com/services/hipaa): US healthcare providers, health plans and business associates handling protected health information.
- [HITRUST](https://gvcyber.com/services/hitrust): Healthcare and technology organisations that need a rigorous, certifiable assurance framework.
- [NIST CSF / 800-53](https://gvcyber.com/services/nist-csf-800-53): Organisations aligning security controls with US government and industry guidance.
- [FedRAMP](https://gvcyber.com/services/fedramp): Cloud service providers seeking to serve US federal agencies.
- [DORA](https://gvcyber.com/services/dora): Financial entities and critical ICT providers operating in the European Union.
- [NIS2](https://gvcyber.com/services/nis2): Essential and important entities operating in covered European sectors.
- [SAMA Cyber Security Framework](https://gvcyber.com/services/sama): Banks, insurers, finance companies and other entities regulated by the Saudi Central Bank.
- [CMMC](https://gvcyber.com/services/cmmc): Organisations in the US defence industrial base handling FCI or CUI.
- [CCPA / CPRA](https://gvcyber.com/services/ccpa-cpra): Businesses subject to California consumer privacy requirements.

### Vulnerability scanning
- [Network Vulnerability Scanning](https://gvcyber.com/services/network-vulnerability-scanning): Companies with routers, firewalls and internal networks.
- [Web Application Vulnerability Scanning](https://gvcyber.com/services/web-application-vulnerability-scanning): Organisations with public-facing websites or APIs.
- [Host-Based Vulnerability Scanning](https://gvcyber.com/services/host-based-vulnerability-scanning): Companies managing servers, workstations and endpoints.
- [Database Vulnerability Scanning](https://gvcyber.com/services/database-vulnerability-scanning): Businesses storing sensitive data in SQL or NoSQL databases.
- [Authenticated (Credentialed) Scanning](https://gvcyber.com/services/authenticated-vulnerability-scanning): Organisations needing deep internal system assessment.
- [Unauthenticated (Non-Credentialed) Scanning](https://gvcyber.com/services/unauthenticated-vulnerability-scanning): Companies wanting an external attacker’s view.
- [Cloud-Native Vulnerability Scanning](https://gvcyber.com/services/cloud-native-vulnerability-scanning): Cloud-first companies using containers, serverless services and managed cloud platforms.

### Penetration testing
- [Network Penetration Testing](https://gvcyber.com/services/network-penetration-testing): Companies with internal or external network infrastructure.
- [Web Application Penetration Testing](https://gvcyber.com/services/web-application-penetration-testing): SaaS, eCommerce and organisations with public-facing web applications.
- [Mobile App Penetration Testing](https://gvcyber.com/services/mobile-app-penetration-testing): Companies offering iOS or Android applications to customers or staff.
- [Cloud Infrastructure Penetration Testing](https://gvcyber.com/services/cloud-infrastructure-penetration-testing): Companies using AWS, Azure, GCP or cloud-native services.
- [Social Engineering Penetration Testing](https://gvcyber.com/services/social-engineering-penetration-testing): Organisations that want to test human and process resilience.
- [Wireless Networking Penetration Testing](https://gvcyber.com/services/wireless-network-penetration-testing): Offices, retail locations and manufacturers using Wi-Fi or Bluetooth.
- [IoT / Embedded Systems Penetration Testing](https://gvcyber.com/services/iot-embedded-penetration-testing): Manufacturing, healthcare device and smart-technology companies.
- [CREST-aligned Penetration Testing](https://gvcyber.com/services/crest-penetration-testing): UK organisations and suppliers that need threat-led penetration testing aligned with CREST methodology.

## Industries

- [Financial services](https://gvcyber.com/industries/financial-services): Security audits, PCI DSS readiness, SOC 2 readiness, cloud security review and penetration testing for regulated financial environments.
- [Healthcare](https://gvcyber.com/industries/healthcare): HIPAA readiness, application security, vulnerability scanning and risk review for teams protecting health and patient data.
- [Technology and SaaS](https://gvcyber.com/industries/technology-saas): SOC 2 readiness, ISO 27001 implementation, web application testing, API testing and secure product delivery support.
- [Public sector](https://gvcyber.com/industries/public-sector): Security control mapping, supplier readiness, NIST alignment, Cyber Essentials and vulnerability management support.
- [Retail and ecommerce](https://gvcyber.com/industries/retail-ecommerce): PCI DSS readiness, payment-flow testing, web application penetration testing and customer-data protection review.
- [Critical infrastructure](https://gvcyber.com/industries/critical-infrastructure): Risk assessment, network testing, cloud review and operational resilience support for essential systems.

## Expert suggestions (articles)

- [What to prepare before an ISO 27001 certification audit](https://gvcyber.com/expert-suggestions/iso-27001-readiness-before-certification): A practical readiness checklist for teams that want fewer surprises before formal ISO 27001 assessment.
- [How to make vulnerability scanning useful instead of noisy](https://gvcyber.com/expert-suggestions/vulnerability-scanning-without-noise): Scanning only helps when assets, credentials, validation and remediation ownership are handled properly.
- [PCI secure software requirements and key management](https://gvcyber.com/expert-suggestions/pci-secure-software-key-management): What the PCI Secure Software Framework expects from cryptography and key lifecycle management, and where engineering teams still carry the responsibility.
- [Hardening your Cisco network: a security audit checklist](https://gvcyber.com/expert-suggestions/cisco-network-hardening-audit-checklist): A baseline set of Cisco IOS checks for disabling legacy services, locking down management access, and verifying interface, routing and logging configuration.
- [A vibe coder's guide to security](https://gvcyber.com/expert-suggestions/vibe-coder-guide-to-security): A practical guide for developers using AI assistants to identify, verify and fix common security issues before they ship.

## Illustrative case studies

- [Zero Trust controls for shared customer access](https://gvcyber.com/case-studies/cloudflare-zero-trust-shared-access): A data analytics firm needed rapid access to short-term customer environments without losing accountability when clients only provided shared credentials.
- [Auditing Cisco routers for misconfiguration and legacy risk](https://gvcyber.com/case-studies/cisco-router-network-hardening): A professional services firm regained control of a black-box network, removed ghost devices and improved video stability without replacing all infrastructure immediately.
- [AI governance for a SaaS provider using ISO 42001](https://gvcyber.com/case-studies/iso-42001-ai-governance-saas): A SaaS provider needed a practical AI governance baseline that could support customer assurance, application security and future ISO 42001 readiness.
- [Digital forensics after ransomware in a factory environment](https://gvcyber.com/case-studies/factory-ransomware-digital-forensics): A manufacturing site needed root-cause analysis, malware validation and safer recovery across servers, SAP, thin clients, IP cameras, HMI systems and printers.
